description: Artifact-slim single-Spark recipe for the official MiniMax H3 FL2VA partition: text-to-video-and-audio plus optional first and/or last keyframes. It preserves the pinned Modular Diffusers int8 streamed-offload and verified 24-fps video plus 32-kHz stereo audio contract while excluding Ref2VA and duplicate checkpoint layouts.

num-frames.description: Video length at 24 fps. The model renders 17k+5 frames, 5 to 14 seconds (124 to 345).
num-frames.label: Frames

num-inference-steps.description: More steps refine the video and take longer. The recipe default is 31.
num-inference-steps.label: Denoising steps

title: MiniMax H3 FL2VA local Modular Diffusers single Spark
